def bfs(start_r, start_c):

    component = set()

        visited.add((r, c))
        component.add((r, c))
        # Check neighbors

    return component

def get_clusters_by_distance(threshold=8):
    """Group cells that are close to each other"""
    remaining = set(cells)
    clusters = []
    
    while remaining:
        cell_list = list(remaining)
        cell_dict = {(c[0], c[1]): c for c in cell_list}
        
        seed = cell_dict[cell_list[0][:2]]
        cluster = {seed[:2]}
        
        changed = True
        while changed:
            changed = False
            new_cells = {}
            for key, val in cell_dict.items():
                if key in cluster:
                    continue
                for ck in cluster:
                    dist = abs(val[0] - cell_dict[ck][0]) + abs(val[1] - cell_dict[ck][1])
                    if dist <= threshold:
                        cluster.add(key)
                        new_cells[key] = val
                        break
            cluster.update(new_cells.keys())
            remaining -= set(new_cells.keys())
            
        clusters.append(cluster)
        remaining -= cluster
    
    return clusters

demo_out = G['Demo pair 1 output']
